attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012167578 (CC0): the striped brick-and-stone fronts on their measured 3.5-3.8 m bays, the granite basement with paired small arches, the tall stone-framed arched windows of the ground storey, two arched upper storeys with balconettes, the corbelled cornice and balustrade, the stepped-gable dormers, the central entrance gable between two towers, the polygonal corner tower with its lantern and the corner turret, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0).
